title: Normal-Core Compression for Units in Burnside Rings
summary: Let $G$ be a finite group. We study the additive map on the Burnside ring of $G$ that sends an orbit $[G/H]$ to $[G/\operatorname{core}_G(H)]$, which we call the \emph{normal-core compression}, and investigate its behavior on units. For a normal subgroup $N\trianglelefteq G$, we show that the cumulative $N$-core coefficient is equal to the sum of the orbit-basis coefficients of the $N$-fixed-point element over $G/N$.
